ma.openDocument(Object object)

Open a document on a new page.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes File path (local path), which can be obtained by downloadFile.
fileType String No File type. You can open a file of the specified type.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.fileType
Valid Value Description
doc doc format.
docx docx format.
xls xls format.
xlsx xlsx format.
ppt ppt format.
pptx pptx format.
pdf pdf format.

Sample Code

ma.downloadFile({
  // Example URL.
  url: 'http://example.com/somefile.pdf',
  success: function (res) {
    const filePath = res.tempFilePath;
    ma.openDocument({
      filePath: filePath,
      success: function (res) {
        console.log ('The file is opened.');
      }
    });
  }
});
